problem.title: Your idea is clear. What slows you down is the rest.
problem.body: Login, teams, permissions, billing, emails, queues, an admin panel and deploy. Each piece takes time, and asking an AI to build all of it from scratch tends to give you a different design each time.

auth.title: Login and accounts
auth.text: Email and password, email codes, social login and app-based MFA.

teams.title: Teams and permissions
teams.text: Workspaces, invitations with roles and permissions by role.

billing.title: Billing
billing.text: Plans, checkout, customer portal and webhooks with Stripe, and Paddle as an alternative.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.text: Accounts, plans, queues and audit in a separate area protected by MFA.

realtime.title: Realtime and background jobs
realtime.text: Live notifications and background jobs on Cloudflare.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.text: One command publishes the app to your Cloudflare account.

method.title: A method for your AI to follow, instead of trial and error
method.body: Fireskills comes with the kit. You describe the idea; the AI writes the spec, then the tests and finally the code, with specialists for each part of the project.

idea.title: Describe the idea
idea.text: Say in one sentence what you want to build.

spec.title: Approve the spec
spec.text: The AI turns the idea into rules and scenarios you check before any code is written.

ship.title: Ship
ship.text: The tests pass, the docs are updated and the deploy goes out with one command.

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.forText: You build SaaS with the help of AI, such as Cursor and Claude Code, and want to start from a ready base instead of assembling every piece.
audience.notTitle: It may not be for you if
audience.notText: You are looking for a no-code tool: here you edit TypeScript. Or you do not plan to publish on Cloudflare.

testimonials.title: Who has used it
testimonials.subtitle: More than 10 devs have tested Nuxfire.

item1.name: Alex Rivera
item1.quote: Configuring multi-tenancy auth and Stripe webhooks usually takes weeks on every project. With Nuxfire, I had billing and team management live in a single weekend...

item2.name: Marcus Vance
item2.quote: The Cloudflare Workers and Hyperdrive Postgres setup is insanely fast. Zero cold starts across global edges, and the SST deployment pipeline worked on the first try...

item3.name: Elena Rostova
item3.quote: Most boilerplates give you fragile code that breaks with real users. Nuxfire has proper RBAC, invite flows, and audit logs wired up. Saved me 2 months of work...

item4.name: Liam O'Connor
item4.quote: I was skeptical about running Nuxt 4 and Drizzle on edge Workers, but the architecture is brilliant. Clean separation between Web, App, and Auth without complexity...

item5.name: Sofia Mendes
item5.quote: The real-time WebSocket Durable Objects and background queue setup out of the box is what sold me. We replaced our old Redis BullMQ stack and cut bills to zero...

item6.name: Daniel Zhao
item6.quote: Nuxt UI v4 components with D1 content docs and Stripe customer portal integration made launching our B2B app effortless. Built by senior engineers for production...

item7.name: Kavita Patel
item7.quote: The end-to-end type safety between Drizzle ORM and tRPC is immaculate. Refactoring schemas never causes hidden runtime bugs. Easily the best Nuxt starter kit...

item8.name: Jordan Blake
item8.quote: Stop wasting time building auth and team permissions from scratch. We migrated our MVP to Nuxfire and shipped our first paid subscriptions 48 hours later. Worth it...

faq.title: Questions from people about to buy

needs.question: What do I need to know to use it?
needs.answer: The basics of TypeScript and the command line, and a Cloudflare account. The rest is in the documentation.

commercial.question: Can I use it in commercial and client projects?
commercial.answer: Yes: the license lets you create as many end products as you like and sell them. It does not allow redistributing the code itself, and freelancers need one license per client. Read the full terms on the license page.

updates.question: Which updates are included?
updates.answer: {months} months of updates are included in the price, with no subscription.

contact.answer: On the support WhatsApp. We arrange a conversation and answer your questions before the purchase.
